3968-4050-4078-6772.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-6772.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Syr Vondam triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam for each trigger.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-7918.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

851-4365-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-4365-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7297-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1580-2511-3220-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7444-7750.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Advanced Reconstruction is at least level 3.
3532-5078-7444-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

513-6896-7178.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-6896-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-889-1618-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Deekah
80-889-1618-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-889-1618-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Deekah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

57-4846-6657-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6657-7296.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1445-5477-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5477-7297.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5256-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5256-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Scrivener.
When Salvager of Secrets and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

483-2173-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2793-3743-4444-5089-6753.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4444-5089-6753.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

678-5670-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5670-6719.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1339-2122-4050-6260.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-6260.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4131-5929.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-4131-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
3767-3918-4131-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2061-2104-2493.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-2493.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2292-5258-5618-6121.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2653-4693-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
2653-4693-5720-5721.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

2921-4881-5011.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

2173-2292-2932-5220.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2292-2932-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-2292-2932-5220.notes: The creature with mana value 1 or less can be Viscera Seer, if desired.

422-1744-2560-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Chandra's Ignition targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Chandra's Ignition, causing the Golem to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Chandra's Ignition.

678-2034-4054-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
678-2034-4054-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
Primeval Bounty's first ability triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

628-1123-2034-3496.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Slaver dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Flayer of the Hatebound triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2585-2751-4131-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five additional artifacts.
1651-2585-2751-4131-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

952-1103-1368-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
952-1103-1368-4050.description:
Cast Flamekin Harbinger from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Flamekin Harbinger enters the battlefield, choose not to search your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flamekin Harbinger, adding {R}.
Flamekin Harbinger dies, triggering Titania's second ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

732-1284-2059.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Felhide Spiritbender.
Felhide Spiritbender does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
732-1284-2059.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {1}{W}.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Felhide Spiritbender triggers, holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbender trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
The token Village Bell-RInger enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 5.
